unit.bookReference: Lesson 13 Dialogue I opening (turns 1–6), Vocabulary I entries 1–8 plus Phrases 19–21.
unit.label: Birthday calls, returning & remembering
unit.title: Tomorrow Is Your Birthday
unit.description: Begin this lesson with a birthday phone call: identify yourself, greet someone after a long time, say you came back, react to forgetting, and say you remember.

goal.text: 啊，我怎麼忘了！謝謝你還記得。
goal.pinyin: A, wǒ zěnme wàng le! Xièxie nǐ hái jìde.
goal.meaning: Oh! How could I forget! Thank you for still remembering.

lessons.title: Hello, This Is Me
lessons.subtitle: Open a friendly phone call with 我就是 and 好久不見.

steps.prompt: On the phone, what does 我就是 mean here?
steps.explanation: In the phone call, 我就是 identifies the speaker after the caller asks for that person.

steps.prompt: When is 好久不見 appropriate?
options: When you have not seen or spoken to someone for a long time
When you are meeting someone for the first time
When you want to say good night
steps.answer: When you have not seen or spoken to someone for a long time
steps.explanation: 好久不見 is the fixed greeting 'Long time no see.'

steps.prompt: Which opening best fits a phone call?
steps.explanation: 喂 is the already-known phone greeting. The rule here uses the person's name after 喂; Hanzi Steps keeps the line learner-safe.

lessons.title: Happy Birthday
lessons.subtitle: Learn 生日, 快樂, and the fixed greeting 生日快樂.

steps.prompt: 生日 means…
steps.explanation: 生日 is 'birthday'.

steps.prompt: 快樂 means…
steps.explanation: 快樂 means 'happy'.

steps.prompt: How is 樂 pronounced in 快樂?
steps.explanation: 快樂 is kuàilè. Earlier 音樂 is yīnyuè, so 樂 has a different reading here.

steps.prompt: Listen for the birthday greeting.
steps.explanation: 生日快樂 means 'Happy birthday!'

steps.prompt: Which phrase would you say to a friend on their birthday?
steps.explanation: 生日快樂 is the fixed birthday greeting.

lessons.title: I Just Came Back
lessons.subtitle: Use 回來 in the source return-from-Taitung line.

steps.prompt: 回來 means…
steps.explanation: 回來 means to come back toward the speaker/current place.

steps.prompt: In 我剛從臺東回來, 剛 means…
steps.explanation: 剛 is review vocabulary meaning 'just / just now'.

steps.prompt: Listen for the word meaning 'come back'.
steps.explanation: The sentence ends with 回來, 'come back'.

steps.prompt: Which sentence means 'I just came back from Taitung'?
steps.explanation: 從 marks the origin; 回來 is 'come back.'

lessons.title: How Could I Forget?
lessons.subtitle: Learn 啊, 忘, and the reaction use of 怎麼.

steps.prompt: 忘 means…
steps.explanation: 忘 means 'to forget'.

steps.prompt: What does 啊 signal in 啊，我怎麼忘了！?
steps.explanation: Here 啊 marks the speaker's sudden realization.

steps.prompt: In 我怎麼忘了, 怎麼 is closest to…
steps.explanation: This is the reaction use of already-known 怎麼, not a question about method.

steps.prompt: In 啊，我怎麼忘了！, what is safest to learn from this example?
options: 忘了 means 'forgot' here; do not treat 了 as a universal past-tense ending.
Every past sentence must contain 了.
steps.answer: 忘了 means 'forgot' here; do not treat 了 as a universal past-tense ending.
steps.explanation: This example gives you the natural chunk 忘了, 'forgot'. Chinese 了 has more than one function.

lessons.title: I Remember
lessons.subtitle: Learn 記得 and contrast remembering with forgetting.

steps.prompt: 記得 means…
steps.explanation: 記得 means 'to remember'.

steps.prompt: Which pair is opposite in this unit?
steps.explanation: 忘 is 'forget'; 記得 is 'remember'.

steps.prompt: Listen for the word meaning 'remember'.
steps.explanation: 記得 is the remembered action in the sentence.

lessons.title: Of Course I Remember
lessons.subtitle: Learn 當然 and rebuild the first six turns of the birthday call.

steps.prompt: 當然 means…
steps.explanation: 當然 expresses certainty: 'of course'.

steps.prompt: After 好久不見 and the return update, what does the caller reveal?
steps.explanation: the conversation move from the reason for calling to the birthday reminder and the listener's surprised reaction.

steps.prompt: Which reply naturally follows 啊，我怎麼忘了！最近太忙了。?
steps.explanation: The listener thanks the caller for remembering the birthday.

lessons.title: Unit 37 Review
lessons.subtitle: Retrieve the birthday-call vocabulary, four new characters, and source conversation foundation.

steps.prompt: Listen for the word meaning 'forget'.
steps.explanation: 忘 means 'forget'.

steps.prompt: Listen for 'remember'.
steps.explanation: 記得 means 'remember'.

steps.prompt: Listen for 'of course'.
steps.explanation: 當然 means 'of course; certainly'.

steps.prompt: Which two characters form 當然?
steps.explanation: 當然 is written 當 + 然.

steps.prompt: 生日 means…
steps.explanation: 生日 is 'birthday'.

steps.prompt: 回來 means…
steps.explanation: 回來 means 'come back; return here'.

steps.prompt: In 啊，我怎麼忘了！, 啊 expresses…
steps.explanation: 啊 marks the sudden realization that the birthday was forgotten.

steps.prompt: Which phrase identifies yourself when someone asks for you on the phone?
steps.explanation: 我就是 is the phone self-identification formula.

steps.prompt: Which fixed greeting means 'Long time no see'?
steps.explanation: 好久不見 is 'Long time no see.'

steps.prompt: In 快樂, 樂 is pronounced…
steps.explanation: 快樂 is kuàilè; compare 音樂 yīnyuè.

steps.prompt: In 啊，我怎麼忘了！, 怎麼 means…
steps.explanation: The speaker is reacting in surprise, not asking about method.

steps.prompt: Your friend says, 'You remembered my birthday!' Which reply means 'Of course I remember!'?
steps.explanation: 當然記得 is the natural transfer of the unit's remembering language.

newVocabulary.meaning: this is me speaking (on the phone)
newVocabulary.note: Fixed phone self-identification formula from this lesson.
Fixed greeting after not seeing/speaking to someone for a long time.
樂 is lè here; compare earlier 音樂 yīnyuè.

忘.note: 忘 is fourth-tone wàng, 'to forget'. In the reaction 我怎麼忘了, it means 'How could I forget!'
忘.memory: Put 亡 'lost/gone' above 心 'heart': when something is gone from the heart/mind, you 忘 'forget'.

parts.label: 亡
parts.name: 亡 component
parts.description: The first three strokes form 亡 at the top.

parts.label: 心
parts.name: heart component
parts.description: The final four strokes form 心 at the bottom.

記.note: 記 is fourth-tone jì. In 記得 jìde it contributes the idea of remembering.
記.memory: Write 言 'speech/words' on the left and 己 on the right: words kept for oneself can be 記 'recorded/remembered'.

parts.label: 言
parts.name: speech component
parts.description: The first seven strokes form 言 on the left.

parts.label: 己
parts.name: 己 component
parts.description: The final three strokes form 己 on the right.

當.meaning: to be; act as; in 當然 'of course'
當.note: 當 is first-tone dāng in 當然 dāngrán, the this lesson word for 'of course / certainly'.
當.memory: Build 尚 on top and 田 below; together they form 當.

parts.label: 尚
parts.name: 尚 component
parts.description: The first eight strokes form 尚 at the top.

parts.label: 田
parts.name: field component
parts.description: The final five strokes form 田 at the bottom.

然.meaning: so; thus; in 當然 'of course'
然.note: 然 is second-tone rán. In this unit it is learned inside 當然 dāngrán, 'of course / certainly'.
然.memory: The upper eight strokes form the 肰-like body (月 plus 犬), and the four-dot fire 灬 finishes 然 at the bottom.

parts.label: 月
parts.name: meat/moon-shaped component
parts.description: The first four strokes form the 月-shaped component at upper left.

parts.label: 犬
parts.name: dog component
parts.description: The next four strokes form 犬 at upper right.

parts.label: 灬
parts.name: four-dot fire
parts.description: The final four strokes form 灬 across the bottom.

u37-call-safe.note: Learner-safe adaptation of the opening, which uses the addressee's proper name after 喂. The name is omitted so proper-name characters do not become handwriting targets.

u37-phone-me.meaning: Yes, this is he / this is me speaking.
u37-phone-me.note: phone formula. Here 我就是 identifies the speaker on the phone; do not generalize it into a new 就是 grammar rule.

u37-long-time.note: Fixed greeting used when meeting or speaking after a long time.

u37-happy-birthday.note: Fixed birthday greeting. 樂 is pronounced lè here; compare earlier 音樂 yīnyuè.

u37-return-taitung.meaning: I just came back from Taitung.
u37-return-taitung.note: Learner-safe core of the conversation. The source first denies going to Hualien; Hanzi Steps keeps that place-name character out of learner-facing Chinese.

u37-purpose.meaning: What did you want to see me about?
u37-purpose.note: This conversation 找我 here is naturally 'look for / come see me'.

u37-birthday-confirm.text: 明天是你的生日，對不對？
u37-birthday-confirm.pinyin: Míngtiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, duì bu duì?
u37-birthday-confirm.note: This conversation 對不對 is review support, not a new canonical vocabulary item.

u37-forget-source.note: In this reaction, 忘了 is learned as the fixed chunk 'forgot'; Unit 39 later teaches completed-action verbal 了 as a general system.

u37-too-busy.note: This conversation support. This final 了 is already-familiar sentence-final usage; Unit 37 does not introduce a new 了 rule.

u37-remember-source.note: This conversation with the source's gender-specific second-person form normalized to 你.

u37-of-course-source.note: This conversation opening, used here to close the remembering sequence before Unit 38 continues the turn.
